notes:
PocketScanTCG 0.6.1 fixes the condition photo viewer.

- The viewer is inline instead of a full-screen overlay, so the page header, bottom nav and front/back/surface tabs stay reachable; zoom and pan still work inside the image viewport.
- Marks are filtered to the photo being viewed: front damage is drawn only on the front, back damage only on the back, and the angled surface photo carries no boxes.
- Jumping to a mark from the review list now opens the photo that mark belongs to.
- New Solid/Faint/Off control for mark boxes, remembered between sessions.

Debug build of the PocketScanTCG Android app (debug-signed). Sideload for testing.
